// Sample large code for performance testing
// This file is approximately 100KB to test performance and scalability.

// Function 1
function greet(name) {
  return `Hello, ${name}!`;
}

console.log(greet('World'));

// Function 2
function add(a, b) {
  return a + b;
}

console.log(add(1, 2));

// Function 3
function multiply(a, b) {
  return a * b;
}

console.log(multiply(3, 4));

// Function 4
function divide(a, b) {
  if (b === 0) {
    throw new Error('Cannot divide by zero');
  }
  return a / b;
}

console.log(divide(10, 2));

// Function 5
function isEven(num) {
  return num % 2 === 0;
}

console.log(isEven(4));

// Function 6
function factorial(n) {
  if (n <= 1) return 1;
  return n * factorial(n - 1);
}

console.log(factorial(5));

// Function 7
function sumArray(arr) {
  return arr.reduce((acc, val) => acc + val, 0);
}

console.log(sumArray([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]));

// Function 8
function filterEven(arr) {
  return arr.filter((num) => num % 2 === 0);
}

console.log(filterEven([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]));

// Function 9
function mapArray(arr, fn) {
  return arr.map(fn);
}

console.log(mapArray([1, 2, 3], (x) => x * 2));

// Function 10
function reduceArray(arr, fn, initialValue) {
  return arr.reduce(fn, initialValue);
}

console.log(reduceArray([1, 2, 3], (acc, val) => acc + val, 0));

// Function 11
function findMax(arr) {
  return Math.max(...arr);
}

console.log(findMax([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]));

// Function 12
function findMin(arr) {
  return Math.min(...arr);
}

console.log(findMin([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]));

// Function 13
function reverseString(str) {
  return str.split('').reverse().join('');
}

console.log(reverseString('hello'));

// Function 14
function countChars(str) {
  return str.length;
}

console.log(countChars('hello'));

// Function 15
function capitalize(str) {
  return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
}

console.log(capitalize('hello'));

// Function 16
function isPalindrome(str) {
  return str === reverseString(str);
}

console.log(isPalindrome('racecar'));

// Function 17
function flattenArray(arr) {
  return arr.flat();
}

console.log(flattenArray([1, [2, 3], 4]));

// Function 18
function uniqueArray(arr) {
  return [...new Set(arr)];
}

console.log(uniqueArray([1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4]));

// Function 19
function chunkArray(arr, size) {
  const chunks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) {
    chunks.push(arr.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return chunks;
}

console.log(chunkArray([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], 2));

// Function 20
function mergeObjects(obj1, obj2) {
  return { ...obj1, ...obj2 };
}

console.log(mergeObjects({ a: 1 }, { b: 2 }));

// Repeat functions to reach ~100KB
